question: In the context of British rule in India, who among the following became the first Governor-General after the post of Governor was elevated to Governor-General of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Warren Hastings**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Warren Hastings** became the first Governor-General of Bengal after the post of Governor was elevated to Governor-General in 1773.
 
• This elevation was a result of the **Regulating Act of 1773**, which aimed to address the administrative inefficiencies and corruption within the East India Company.
 
• As the first Governor-General, Warren Hastings played a crucial role in laying the administrative framework for British India.
 
• His tenure marked significant changes in the judicial and revenue systems.
 
• Hastings also faced impeachment in Britain for his actions in India, although he was eventually acquitted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The position of Governor-General of Bengal was later expanded to Governor-General of India in 1833, with increased authority over British territories in India.
 
• The Regulating Act of 1773 was a significant step towards centralizing British administration in India, laying the foundation for future governance structures.
 
• Warren Hastings' administrative reforms had a lasting impact on the Indian subcontinent, influencing subsequent policies and governance strategies.
 
• His tenure also saw the beginning of British involvement in regional conflicts and diplomatic relations with Indian states.
